accessibility.evidence: Semantic main landmark, labeled theme controls, four labeled module buttons, dialog labeling, Escape handling, focus restoration, visible focus styles, and reduced-motion CSS are implemented and covered by the Jarvis contract test.

responsive.evidence: Desktop, tablet, and mobile breakpoint rules are present with no intentional fixed-width page surface; mobile controls use horizontal scrollers and the dialog becomes a full-height sheet.

loading.evidence: Boot sequence is rendered first and transitions to Systems online after the local startup timer.

empty.reason: The prototype has no account-backed collection or empty-data view.

error.evidence: The interrupted signal state has explicit copy and a local signal-check recovery action.

partial.evidence: The standby signal state keeps the bridge usable while clearly reporting reduced telemetry.

success.evidence: Nominal systems-online state exposes active telemetry, theme controls, module controls, and the Open bridge action.

permission.reason: The prototype performs no account, file, or permission-gated operation.
